asyncapi:
asyncapi: 3.0.0
info: { title: Readings, version: "1" }
channels:
  readings:
    address: /devices/{deviceId}
    parameters:
      deviceId: { description: The device }
    messages:
      reading:
        payload:
          type: object
          required: [temp]
          properties:
            temp: { type: number, maximum: 100 }
            at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      status:
        payload:
          type: object
          required: [online]
          properties:
            online: { type: boolean }
          additionalProperties: false
operations:
  receiveReadings:
    action: receive
    channel: { $ref: "#/channels/readings" }
